svg.title: Saksham Srivastava — I build the part nobody sees, and everybody depends on.
svg.desc: Backend engineer, AI engineer, Android app builder and co-founder of Sqaron Technologies, from Lucknow, India. 872 APIs in production, 8,951 tests, 158 tables, zero downtime. Now shipping LUMIQ 2.0 for Android.
